_comment: Spend caps, quiet hours, and owner-declared unmetered endpoints. Dimensional, not sacred — but the agent cannot raise them itself: this file is the ONLY source of the caps (core/rot/budgets.ts), config.json no longer carries a copy, and only this seal can declare an endpoint unmetered (a model-reachable config never can). Editing it takes effect after `muffin rot reseal` and a restart. UTC is the neutral shipped fallback; first-run/setup owns replacing it with the detected owner timezone before calling the install configured. `unmetered` lists exact endpoint contracts the owner funds outside the metered spend (e.g. a LAN GPU box): { host (exact, case-insensitive), port (optional — absent means any port), note (optional, why) }. Empty means everything not otherwise free is metered.
